query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS synergies (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  tabac_id INT,
  molecule_id INT,
  famille_id INT,
  type ENUM('potentialisation', 'stabilisation', 'transformation', 'masquage') NOT NULL,
  effet TEXT,
  notes TEXT,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  FOREIGN KEY (tabac_id) REFERENCES tabacs(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (molecule_id) REFERENCES molecules(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (famille_id) REFERENCES familles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
);
